moments.title: Premier League Saturday Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up a packed schedule today with key matches including Chelsea vs Hull City and Liverpool vs Fulham, plus Spurs taking on Everton in the late kick-off.

angles.name: Matchday Buzz
angles.copy: It's Premier League Saturday! Who are you backing to grab those crucial three points today? Some big fixtures on the cards.

angles.name: Spurs vs Everton
angles.copy: Spurs host Everton in today's late Premier League kick-off. Can Ange's side keep up their strong start to the season?

moments.title: Reminisce Festival Takes Over St Helens
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest throwback dance festival, Reminisce, returns to Sherdley Park in St Helens today, celebrating 90s and 00s dance, trance, and clubland anthems.

angles.name: Dance Anthem Day
angles.copy: Hands in the air, St Helens! Reminisce Festival is LIVE today bringing back all the classic dance, trance, and clubland anthems from the 90s and 00s. Who's there?

angles.name: Throwback Vibes
angles.copy: Reliving the soundtrack of our youth! Reminisce Festival is happening right now, packed with your favourite 90s and 00s dance tunes.

moments.title: Great River Race on the Thames
moments.blurb: London's famous 21.6-mile Great River Race, a marathon for traditional-style boats, is taking place today on the River Thames from Millwall to Richmond.

angles.name: Thames Spectacle
angles.copy: The Great River Race is underway on the Thames today! Over 330 crews are battling it out in London's unique river marathon. If you're by the river, take a look!

angles.name: London Tradition
angles.copy: From Millwall to Richmond, the Great River Race is bringing a fantastic spectacle to the Thames today. A true London tradition!

moments.title: The O2 Hosts The Waterboys & Luther Live
moments.blurb: Tonight at London's O2 Arena, The Waterboys bring their 'Fisherman's Blues Revue' and 'Luther Live' offers a tribute to the legendary Luther Vandross.

angles.name: Live at The O2
angles.copy: London's O2 Arena is buzzing tonight with The Waterboys' Fisherman's Blues Revue and the incredible Luther Live. Who's heading to Greenwich?

angles.name: Waterboys & Luther
angles.copy: A night of classic sounds at The O2! The Waterboys bring their iconic folk-rock, while Luther Live celebrates the soul legend. What a double bill!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Unveiled
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart for September 10-16 has been revealed, with October London's 'Silent Treatment' claiming the top spot.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: New music reigns! October London's 'Silent Treatment' is officially the UK's No.1 single this week. Have you heard it?

angles.name: Top 40 Buzz
angles.copy: What's in your headphones? The latest UK Singles Chart is out, featuring new entries and big movers. Find out who's in the Top 40!

moments.title: Niall Horan Turns 33
moments.blurb: Former One Direction member and successful solo artist Niall Horan celebrates his 33rd birthday tomorrow, September 13, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Niall
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Tomorrow, Niall Horan turns 33. What's your favourite Niall track, solo or from his One Direction days?

angles.name: 1D Memories
angles.copy: Can you believe Niall Horan will be 33 tomorrow? From global pop sensation to solo star, he's given us so many hits!

moments.title: Big Album Releases Next Week
moments.blurb: Next Friday, September 18, sees new albums dropping from major artists including beabadoobee, Beck, Carly Rae Jepsen, Chaka Khan, and Echo & The Bunnymen.

angles.name: New Music Friday Preview
angles.copy: Next Friday is HUGE for new music! Get ready for fresh albums from beabadoobee, Beck, Carly Rae Jepsen, Chaka Khan, and Echo & The Bunnymen. What are you most excited for?

angles.name: Album Drops
angles.copy: From indie rock to disco legends, there's something for everyone on next week's new album list! Who are you listening to first?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Approaches
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox, marking the start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, will occur on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 01:05 BST. English Heritage offers free access to Stonehenge.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: The nights are drawing in... The Autumn Equinox is just under two weeks away, officially marking the start of astronomical autumn on September 23rd!

angles.name: Stonehenge Equinox
angles.copy: Fancy an early start? English Heritage is offering free managed access to Stonehenge for the Autumn Equinox on September 23rd. A truly special seasonal moment.

moments.title: London Design & Open House Festivals Begin
moments.blurb: Today marks the start of both the London Design Festival and the Open House Festival, running until September 20th, showcasing the capital's creativity and offering public access to unique buildings.

angles.name: Design Capital
angles.copy: London is a hub of creativity! The London Design Festival kicks off today, transforming the city into a giant gallery until Sept 20th. Get out and explore!

angles.name: Hidden Gems Unlocked
angles.copy: Ever wanted to peek inside London's most iconic or unusual buildings? The Open House Festival also starts today, offering rare public access across the capital. Don't miss it!

moments.title: British Science Festival in Southampton
moments.blurb: The British Science Festival, a five-day event celebrating science with talks, workshops, and performances for an adult audience, begins in Southampton on September 16th.

angles.name: Science in Southampton
angles.copy: Get your geek on! The British Science Festival kicks off in Southampton on September 16th, promising five days of fascinating insights, workshops, and performances.

angles.name: Curiosity Calling
angles.copy: From comedy to art installations, the British Science Festival is back next week in Southampton. Perfect for anyone with a curious mind!

moments.title: York Food and Drink Festival Returns
moments.blurb: One of Britain's biggest foodie events, the York Food and Drink Festival, celebrates local and regional produce with tastings and demonstrations from September 18-27.

angles.name: Foodie Paradise
angles.copy: Calling all food lovers! The York Food and Drink Festival starts next Friday, September 18th, promising delicious local produce and culinary delights. Who's hungry?

angles.name: Taste of Yorkshire
angles.copy: Get ready for a feast! York's massive Food and Drink Festival is back next week, showcasing the best of local and regional food and drink until the 27th.

moments.title: Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival
moments.blurb: The Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival offers two days of delicious food, handmade crafts, local art, and live entertainment at Downhills Park, London, from September 19-20.

angles.name: Harvest in Tottenham
angles.copy: Next weekend, Downhills Park in Tottenham hosts the Harvest Food & Makers Festival! Get ready for tasty bites, local crafts, and good vibes.

angles.name: Support Local Makers
angles.copy: Looking for weekend plans? The Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival on Sept 19-20 is the perfect spot to enjoy local food, art, and support small businesses!

moments.title: Hilary Duff Continues O2 Arena Run
moments.blurb: Hilary Duff brings her 'Lucky Me Tour' back to London's O2 Arena on Tuesday, September 15th, for her second show in the capital this month.

angles.name: Hilary's Back
angles.copy: Lizzie McGuire is in London! Hilary Duff returns to The O2 Arena on Tuesday for another night on her 'Lucky Me Tour'. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: 00s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Relive your 00s pop dreams! Hilary Duff is live at The O2 on Tuesday. What's your favourite track from her latest album?

moments.title: Nathan Dawe New Music Tease
moments.blurb: While not confirmed for today, Nathan Dawe is known for teasing new music around this time of year, often leading to chart success for the UK DJ and producer.

angles.name: Dawe's Next Drop
angles.copy: Keep your ears peeled! Nathan Dawe often drops new music around now. What kind of banger are you hoping for next from the UK hitmaker?

angles.name: Anticipating the Drop
angles.copy: Nathan Dawe knows how to get the party started. Could new music be on the horizon? What's your go-to Nathan Dawe track?

moments.title: Caribbean Premier League Continues
moments.blurb: The Caribbean Premier League (CPL) T20 cricket tournament is in full swing, with matches continuing through September 20th.

angles.name: CPL Fever
angles.copy: It's CPL season! The Caribbean Premier League is delivering explosive T20 cricket action right now. Who are you rooting for in the 'Biggest Party in Sport'?

angles.name: Cricket Heat
angles.copy: Catch the thrilling T20 action! The Caribbean Premier League continues with its high-energy matches throughout the week.
